projects.title: Malaria Detection with Deep Learning
projects.description: Developed and optimized a CNN (EfficientNetB3) to classify blood smear images as parasitized or uninfected, utilizing OpenCV for advanced image preprocessing and noise reduction. Implemented comprehensive data augmentation strategies and hyperparameter tuning to mitigate overfitting, ultimately achieving 94% classification accuracy for potential clinical application.

projects.title: Reinforcement Learning vs Large Language Model in Chess Engine
projects.description: Developed a chess-playing agent using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and compared it with LLM-based move generation for strategic decision-making. Integrated OpenAI Gym environments with custom chess logic to simulate and train agents against established open-source engines. Conducted a comparative analysis highlighting key differences in reward shaping, state representation, and long-term planning between RL and LLM approaches.

experience.title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Developed and evaluated machine learning models for detecting phishing emails, leveraging NLP-based features to identify malicious intent.
Engineered a robust feature extraction pipeline using TF-IDF and n-grams to analyze email body text, headers, and sender/domain patterns with Python and Scikit-learn.
Trained and compared Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and SVM models using precision, recall, and F1-score to determine the most effective classifier.
Managed end-to-end data preprocessing workflows, including text cleaning, handling class imbalance via oversampling, and ensuring model stability through cross-validation.
Analyzed URL patterns and domain reputation to improve detection accuracy and reduce false positive rates in real-time classification scenarios.
